messages.content: Generate 1,000 deterministic sales rows (seeded PRNG, regions North/South/East/West, dates across 2025) in Rust, compute revenue totals per quarter and per region, and write them to /work/artifacts/result.json. Print the grand total.

{"tool":"delegate","role":"coder","task":"Write a self-contained Rust 2024 program (standard library only) that runs in a disposable gVisor sandbox (no network, 64 MiB writable /work, bounded memory/CPU/time). Requirements:
1. Generate exactly 1,000 deterministic sales rows using a seeded PRNG (implement a simple LCG/xorshift yourself; do not use external crates). Each row: region (one of North/South/East/West), a date within 2025 (YYYY-MM-DD), an amount (e.g., integer cents or f64 dollars, deterministic from the PRNG).
2. Compute revenue totals per quarter (Q1=Jan-Mar, Q2, Q3, Q4 of 2025) and per region (North/South/East/West), plus a grand total.

5. Print the grand total to stdout.
6. Compile and run it in the sandbox; verify result.json exists, is valid JSON, contains 1000 rows, and the printed grand total matches the JSON grand_total. Report the grand total value and confirmation that all assertions passed."}

Write a self-contained Rust 2024 program (standard library only) that runs in a disposable gVisor sandbox (no network, 64 MiB writable /work, bounded memory/CPU/time). Requirements:
1. Generate exactly 1,000 deterministic sales rows using a seeded PRNG (implement a simple LCG/xorshift yourself; do not use external crates). Each row: region (one of North/South/East/West), a date within 2025 (YYYY-MM-DD), an amount (e.g., integer cents or f64 dollars, deterministic from the PRNG).
2. Compute revenue totals per quarter (Q1=Jan-Mar, Q2, Q3, Q4 of 2025) and per region (North/South/East/West), plus a grand total.
3. Write /work/artifacts/result.json containing: rows (all 1,000 rows), totals_per_quarter (object with keys Q1..Q4), totals_per_region (object with the four region keys), and grand_total. Create the /work/artifacts directory if needed.
4. Assert in the program: row count == 1000; every region is one of the four; every date parses and is within 2025; sum of quarterly totals == grand_total; sum of regional totals == grand_total. Panic/exit nonzero if any assertion fails.
5. Print the grand total to stdout.
6. Compile and run it in the sandbox; verify result.json exists, is valid JSON, contains 1000 rows, and the printed grand total matches the JSON grand_total. Report the grand total value and confirmation that all assertions passed.
